cut: v2 (owner, 18 Oct: 'Welcome is not making much sense') — the irony inside the ad itself: her messages are private, her boyfriend is family viewing
argument: The home screen's own launch ad sells privacy: her brother can't read her messages, yet its happy ending is the whole family watching her leave with her boyfriend on its camera.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: A home screen's launch ad / sells privacy. / But [whose]?
text.ja: ホーム画面の 発表広告は / プライバシーを 売る。 / でも [誰の]？

captions.source: The launch film of a home display that recognises up to six household members by face and shows each their own messages and calendar (Apple Newsroom via MacRumors and Mac Observer, 13 Oct 2026; Tom's Guide; ABC). On screen the device is unbranded, as Doodle and Teslur were; the tag says it is a real ad, remade.

text.en: In the ad, her brother tries / to read her messages. / Only her face [unlocks] them.
text.fi: Mainoksessa veli yrittää / lukea siskonsa viestit. / Vain hänen kasvonsa / [avaavat] ne.
text.ja: 広告では 兄弟が 彼女の / メッセージを 見ようとする。 / 開けるのは [彼女の顔]だけ。

captions.source: In the launch film the brother tries to open his sister's messages on the display and fails, because it shows them only to her face (heise; Inc., Jason Aten). Messages and Calendar are shown only when the enrolled user's face is recognised (Apple Newsroom, via MacRumors and Mac Observer).

text.en: Its happy ending: / the family watches her leave / with her boyfriend, / on its door [camera].
text.fi: Onnellinen loppu: / perhe katsoo, kun hän lähtee / poikaystävänsä kanssa, / sen [ovikamerasta].
text.ja: ハッピーエンド： 家族は / 彼氏と 出かける 彼女を / [玄関カメラで] 見る。

captions.source: The launch film ends with the whole family gathered round the display, using the security camera to watch the daughter leave with her boyfriend (Digital Today citing The Verge; Analytics Insight). Staged in clay with generic masked figures: no actor, no footage, no logo.

text.en: Her messages: private. / Her boyfriend: [family viewing].
text.ja: メッセージは 非公開。 / 彼氏は [家族で 視聴]。

captions.source: The station's line, over the door camera's own view: 3 WATCHING.

tag.en: A REAL AD, REMADE IN CLAY
tag.ja: 実在の広告を粘土で再現

locked.ja: ロック中 · 本人の顔ではありません

hoop.why: the embroidery-hoop opener, stitched round a rainbow pear (never the real logo)

post.en: A home screen's launch ad sells privacy: her brother can't read her messages, because only her face unlocks them. Its happy ending? The whole family watching her leave with her boyfriend on its door camera. Her messages: private. Her boyfriend: family viewing. #privacy #smarthome
post.fi: Kotinäytön julkaisumainos myy yksityisyyttä: veli ei pääse lukemaan siskonsa viestejä, koska vain hänen kasvonsa avaavat ne. Onnellinen loppu? Koko perhe katsoo ovikamerasta, kun hän lähtee poikaystävänsä kanssa. Viestit: yksityisiä. Poikaystävä: perheen ohjelmaa.
post.ja: ホーム画面の発表広告はプライバシーを売る。兄弟は彼女のメッセージを見られない。開けるのは彼女の顔だけ。ハッピーエンドは？家族全員が玄関カメラで、彼氏と出かける彼女を見る。メッセージは非公開。彼氏は家族で視聴。
